lineage.strategy: Acquire recent issuer operating evidence with both realized financials and forward execution signals.

observations.fact: Q2 2026 revenue was $508 million, approximately flat year over year; six-month operating cash flow was $210 million and capex was $51 million. Mobileye raised the midpoint of full-year revenue guidance and narrowed the range to $1.97-$2.02 billion.

Mobileye announced Cloud-Enhanced ADAS integration into select future Stellantis vehicles expected in 2027; REM coverage exceeds 95% of public roads in the U.S. and Europe and five of the ten largest automakers contribute data.

risks.risk: Q2 revenue growth was flat and product mix pressured gross margin; forward Stellantis integration is planned for 2027 and remains execution-dependent.

unknowns.unknown: The Stellantis announcement does not disclose unit volumes, contract value, pricing or margin contribution.

recommendation: Use Q2 realized cash/revenue evidence plus Stellantis adoption as source-addressed operating inputs; preserve unknown contract economics.
